SELECT * from ( SELECT u.*, 0 as bind_type, u.username as bind_target, d.name as dept_name FROM role r join users_roles ur on ur.role_id=#{roleId} and ur.role_id = r.id join `user` u on ur.user_id = u.id and u.`status`=1 join dept d on u.dept_id = d.id where r.id=#{roleId}
and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))
union ALL SELECT u.*, 1 as bind_type, d.name as bind_target, d.name as dept_name FROM depts_roles dr join dept d on dr.role_id=#{roleId} and dr.dept_id=d.id join `user` u on u.dept_id = d.id and u.`status`=1 where 1=1
and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))
union ALL SELECT u.*, 2 as bind_type, g.group_name as bind_target, d.name as dept_name from groups_roles gr join `group` g on gr.role_id=#{roleId} and gr.group_id=g.id join groups_users gu on g.id = gu.group_id join `user` u on gu.user_id = u.id join dept d on u.dept_id = d.id where 1=1
and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))
)a order by a.created_time desc

and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))

and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))

select count(1) FROM `role` r join roles_permission rp on r.id = rp.role_id join permission p on p.pid=0 and rp.permission_id =p.id and p.status!=2 join application a on r.app_id = a.id left join ( select p1.pid, count(1) as cou FROM permission p1 where p1.status=1 group by p1.pid ) p2 on p.id = p2.pid where r.id=#{roleId}
and (p.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or p.sign like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') )
SELECT r.* FROM role r join depts_roles dr on dr.dept_id=#{deptId} and dr.role_id = r.id
SELECT r.* FROM role r join groups_roles gr on gr.group_id=#{groupId} and gr.role_id = r.id
